response.sql: WITH per_gender AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS per_gender_average FROM per_gender) SELECT AVG(p.invoiced_orders) AS average_invoiced_orders, AVG(p.invoiced_orders - b.per_gender_average) AS average_excess FROM per_gender AS p CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE p.invoiced_orders > b.per_gender_average;
